verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at https://www.assemblyai.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key). The agent-instructions docs also reference an API spec bundled into the agent integration prompt, which can be skipped with ?excludeSpec=true. Missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly describing the OpenAPI download and its coverage (e.g., whether the streaming WebSocket API is included)
